result.instructions: Tools for Daras, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which products are low on stock, and in which warehouse?"; "Show the open fulfillment orders that are on hold."; "Find the return requests that are waiting for approval.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Daras data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run daras_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run daras_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run daras_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. daras_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: daras_update_variant
tools.title: Update a product variant
tools.description: Change a variant's name, barcode, price, compare-at price or low-stock threshold. This changes the live shop price or label. Set only the fields to change. Merchant API: PATCH /catalog/variants/{id}.

id.description: The id from a list call.

price.description: New selling price, in the store currency.

lowStockThreshold.description: Stock level that triggers the low-stock list.

tools.name: daras_set_warehouse_stock
tools.title: Set warehouse stock
tools.description: Set the on-hand quantity of one product (or variant) in one warehouse. It replaces the stored quantity, so repeating the call gives the same result. This changes live stock. Merchant API: POST /warehouses/stock.

warehouseId.description: The id from a list call.

productId.description: The id from a list call.

variantId.description: Variant id, when the product has variants.

quantity.description: New on-hand quantity (replaces the old value).

incoming.description: Quantity on order, not yet received.

lowStockThreshold.description: Stock level that triggers the low-stock list.
